cli.reason: Packages Service Host recovery and the shared schemas for optional Core-to-Hub read diagnostics. Existing CLI commands, JSON output, setup, and trace remain compatible.

service.reason: A replacement execution Host waits for recorded work to exit and refuses takeover when ownership is uncertain. Busy Hosts write v3 receipts; quiescent v2 receipts support rollback. The optional Hub diagnostic headers preserve existing Service connections, readiness reports, and Wake and result contracts, so no compatibility floor is raised.
